truth.description: injectSourcesContent now keeps the sourcesContent a map already carries, but the maps it is handed come from TransformContext._getCombinedSourcemap in pluginContainer.ts, which merges the incoming map with each plugin map through combineSourcemaps without passing excludeContent as false, so once any plugin returns a map (vite:css under css.devSourcemap, or a user plugin on a JS module) the carried content is stripped before the fill runs and a dependency whose sources are not on disk still loses it and still prints the missing source files warning.

distractions.why: Reusing the map's own sourcesContent array keeps every entry it already carries, and the filled array is assigned back to map.sourcesContent, so the caller sees one consistent array.
